title: Band name
description: The performing band's name. Filled ONLY when the release is by a band (a group of people credited under one name). Leave EMPTY if the release is by a solo artist whose name is the public identity (e.g. 'Maren Sol' has no band name — that goes in M08_artistName instead). Optional.

title: Public-facing artist name
description: The artist name shown to listeners. ALWAYS FILLED — every release has at least one artist name. For a solo release, this is the solo artist's name. For a band release, this is either (a) the front person's name if they're separately credited, or (b) the same as M08_bandName if the band is the only public identity.

title: Credit line (optional)
description: Free-form 'presented as...' / 'a side project of...' / 'performing name of...' line that goes on the release. Optional. Used by ID3 album artist field when M08_bandName and M08_artistName are both filled and you want a third name in the credits.

title: Sonic DNA (locked at brief approval)
description: The frozen-at-approval snapshot of the album's sonic direction. The build skill MUST hold against this on every regen. Any deviation requires explicit user re-approval (the sonic-drift guard). Derived from M03_genre + M05_vocal + R12_production + M07_runtime at brief-approval time. Read-only after approval — to change, re-open the brief.

title: Mastering loudness target
description: Streaming/integrator target. Sets the master stage on finalize. Default: spotify (-14 LUFS).

title: Album sequence & pacing
description: Inter-track gap policy. Default: standard-pause (3-4s).

title: Explicit content rating
description: Will this album have explicit lyrics? Affects Spotify/Apple Music metadata, YouTube content ID flags, distribution approval.

title: Co-writer / producer credits
description: Anyone else to credit? Affects royalty splits + DSP metadata. Default: just you (or just the front person).

title: Sample / cover usage
description: Does the album use any samples or covers? AI music from text prompts is generally 'original' but covers and samples need clearance.

title: Emotional arc across tracks
description: Shape of the listening experience across all 12 tracks. Free-form text — describe the emotional journey.

title: Non-music influences
description: Books, films, places, seasons, weather, people — anything NOT music that shaped this album. (M04 is the music-only version.)

title: Cover art direction
description: What the cover should evoke. Single text field. For richer briefs, use the cover-art generation script directly with your own palette/mood/composition prompt.

title: Physical anchor
description: The ONE object, image, or sensation the listener should remember after the album ends.

title: Press / rollout scope
description: What press + marketing you want. Skipped entirely for just-for-me albums (R14 == just-for-me).

title: Music videos
description: How many music videos to generate. 0 = audio only. Each video costs ~1 weekly video-gen quota slot.

title: Single release deadline
description: Hard deadline for when the album needs to be done. Different from E22 (timeline). E21 = ONE date.

title: Album timeline / sequencing
description: Rough milestone timeline (different from E21 single-deadline). Lets the studio's session manager pace work.

title: Recording session persona
description: Whose story is this? Most albums have a consistent POV. Pick one or say 'varies'.

title: Listener / target audience
description: Who is this album FOR? Affects press kit, marketing copy, lyrics_optimizer register.

title: Physical release intent
description: Any physical format? Cassettes are surprisingly popular in indie scenes. CDs never went away. Vinyl is back.
